active_continuity: Jin Taekyung is trapped in Murim through an old game capsule; death is presented as permanent and he cannot log out at will.
Taekyung is the disgraced third son of the Jin Family of Taiyuan and narrates with dry, self-mocking, occasionally profane humor.
Logout is the Main Quest reward for reaching First Rate, Lv. 30, and 500 Fame.
Taekyung is Lv. 11 after assigning his ten new points to Stamina; Qi Sense detects targets through Lv. 30 within ten jang.
Hyuk Mujin is Lv. 20; after his fight with Taekyung both were taken to the Medicine King Hall.
Jin Wikyung is the thirty-five-year-old Lesser Family Head, and Wipeng is his trusted guard.
Jin Wikyung is Taekyung's thirty-five-year-old older brother, remains unmarried, and is expected to become Family Head; their mother died ten years ago and their father is touring the Central Plains.
Taekyung moved into a Jin Family residence, found hundreds of martial arts manuals, and learned that his System currently shows three of ten martial arts slots occupied.
Taekyung deliberately left a second mass of unassimilated internal energy untouched while circulating qi and is now practicing footwork late into the night.
Wipeng is Jin Wikyung's trusted guard, uses Sound Transmission, and is comfortable teasing him.
open_questions: The capsule's purpose and the route home remain unresolved.
The limits of Murim's death and resurrection rules remain unresolved.
temporary_decisions: The source name 성진호 is Seong Jinho; do not substitute the compendium's separate 송진호 entry.
Preserve brisk dark action-comedy and character hierarchy without archaic wuxia diction.
